guarded_ordered_transitions.behavior: Await model init selected ECU; log title; show G001 view replacing old one. Bind RESET and EXIT. View inserts resetbtn into first-child action strip; click emits reset. No view.initView stub in06/07.

Show DL003 no-button loader. Await start: reset worker.isCancel=false -> startGeneralComm cached ecuId/busId -> transitSession mode3 -> send start frame -> wait300ms -> return {}. NO startKeepAlive. Any failure -> await mode1 then endGeneralComm, swallowing cleanup failures -> reject(undefined). Controller success closes modal, invokes progress DL004 (does not await button), then awaits status method.

while(!model.isCancel): await wait50 -> send result query -> reject if resBody[4]===undefined; byte4===1 continue;2 -> result SUCCESS=1;any other defined byte -> FAILURE=2. Terminal success/failure awaits mode1 then endGeneralComm (both rejection swallowed), returns {result}. Cancellation at loop head -> CANCEL=3 then same cleanup/return. A cancellation arriving during wait/in-flight send can still yield success/failure for that response; controller confirmation overrides. Any thrown/send failure -> same cleanup -> reject(undefined). No deadline or stop-routine frame.

Progress Cancel auto-closes progress and opens DL005; stores deferred.promise() in controller. Yes creates DL003 loader as modal; calls changeCancelFlag WITHOUT await; resolves deferred Yes. No recreates progress modal, resolves No; deferred pointer stays until status success/catch observes it. When status fulfills OR rejects, if deferred pointer non-null await it first; Yes closes modal and emits back overriding status/error;No clears pointer then handles actual result/error. Unrecognized confirmation button never resolves deferred.

SUCCESS1 logs r_item_i6344, closes modal, shows success DL002. FAILURE2 closes modal and shows failure DL001. CANCEL3 has no switch branch when no confirmed Yes. Catch closes modal, invokes comm-error dialog WITHOUT await; neither success/failure/modal button callback is returned from main chain. Success OK navigates. Failure dialog BUTTON_OK is undefined in buttons object (only Yes/No defined); dialog arrButtons id and controller equality both reference undefined. Do not normalize to OK string.
Exit shows DL006 Yes/No; Yes navigates, No recreates main screen. closeDialog only closes/nulls controller.modalView. dispose only main view/dispatcher; navigation no native cleanup.

Show nonselectable grey table and mark selected row className=selected; Stop Inspection button exists disabled AND unbound at controller, Stop Light enabled. Show loader -> await mode1 -> stopKeepAlive -> endGeneralComm, each swallowed -> comResult0 regardless failures (controller ignores result). Log r_item_i6211, close loader, emit back. Direct main exit confirmation only navigates; dispose no session cleanup.

state_fields.worker_cache: data={ecuInfo:<full selected ECU record>,isStopInspection:false,isStartStopLamp:false,isStopStopLamp:false}. Init returns {}. Each setIs* assigns named parameter to same cache flag and returns Promise.resolve({}). Flags not reset on restarting extended session or controller screen rebuild.
state_fields.controller: currentView/modalView=null; duplicate backPreviousScreen assignments occur, latter overrides former with IDENTICAL event-emitting/resolved-Promise body. Dialog constructor base/EventDispatcher; loaderDlg lazy cached.

guarded_ordered_transitions.behavior: Init model with commonInfo current ECU ->001. Table initial value spans empty; Start Inspection enabled, Start actuator disabled, Stop Inspection enabled. Controller binds only Start Inspection and Stop Inspection here; Start actuator emits unused event while disabled. Main Stop Inspection/Exit shows confirmation; Yes resolves ->back; No rejects ->catch swallows; handler does not return confirmation chain.

Show loader then await startGeneralComm({ecuId,busId}) -> startKeepAlive({}) (failure swallowed) -> transitSession({modeId:3}); comm/session rejection triggers mode1 -> stopKeepAlive -> endGeneralComm({}), swallowing cleanup failures then returns {comResult:1}. Success returns0. Controller success then awaits readStopLampInstruction; read0 closes loader and invokes screen002 without awaiting its loop; any error result closes loader and returns comm-error dialog, staying001.

Each read allocates inspectionResult={}, iterates Object.values(INSPECTION_ITEM) IN ORDER, await each read request serially. No inter-request timer or polling delay. For DID use reqType/reqBody constants; if resBody.length<checkLen/checklen reset result={} then reject; otherwise slice off request length3, get checkByte, no mask; convert byte directly then format uppercase2-digit hex with prefix0x; map resultResourceId, missing map -> r_item_i6232. Once ALL DIDs complete, comResult0 then priority: isStopInspection ->4 and clear only that flag; else isStartStopLamp ->2 and clear only it; else isStopStopLamp ->3 and clear only it. On any error -> mode1/stopKeepAlive/endGeneralComm swallowed ->comResult1 and clear only FIRST true flag in same priority order. Previously read entries remain on transport/wrapper failure (only short-length branch clears all). Return {comResult,inspectionResult}.

Dispose old view; show screen002 with enabled Start actuator and Stop Inspection; bind both. While current result comResult0: update every table span with localized inspectionResult resource then await read. Read0 continues immediately. Read2 -> await start actuator; if0 await read again; if that0 close loader and invoke screen003 WITHOUT returning/awaiting its loop. Either failure closes loader -> await comm-error dialog -> show001. Read4 -> await stopInspection (mode1/stopKeepAlive/endGeneralComm swallowed), log r_item_i6223, close loader, back. Any other nonzero read -> close loader, await comm-error dialog, show001. Outer while then stops as resultLoop is nonzero; spawned screen loop independent.

Dispose old view; show003 with enabled Stop actuator; Stop Inspection exists disabled and has no controller listener. While comResult0 update table then await read. Read3 -> await stop actuator then await read; read0 closes loader and invokes002 without awaiting loop. Start/stop/read failures ->close loader, await comm-error dialog, show001. ANY other nonzero read (including4 or2) is generic communication error here; no special full inspection stop branch. No cancellation on view disposal.

Each shows loader and calls corresponding setter(true) WITHOUT await; returns fulfilled async handler immediately. No direct actuator or stop request: action occurs only after full read cycle notices flag. Multiple flags retain lower-priority requests for later reads; read failure clears first only.

Start/stop actuator await utility send once; fulfilled ->{comResult:0}; rejected ->mode1 ->stopKeepAlive ->endGeneralComm({}), swallow cleanup failures ->{comResult:1}. No body/status check beyond helper. stopInspection always mode1 ->stopKeepAlive ->endGeneralComm({}), swallow all ->{comResult:0}. No explicit routine-stop on generic cleanup or dispose.

show loader closes existing controller.modalView and nulls then obtains cached loaderDlg; create only when !loaderDlg. closeLoaderDialog closes/nulls dialog.loaderDlg, leaves controller.modalView reference. Confirmation buttons Yes/No autoClose; Yes resolves, No rejects, other ids fall through/resolve. Back emits event, Promise.resolve; dispose unguarded currentView.disposeView then dispatcher.dispose, no loop stop/session action.

request_construction.session: Selected cached ecuInfo.ecuId/busId to startGeneralComm; send requests have reqType0 and only reqBody (no explicit target/protocol).
request_construction.normalization: No user text/encoding; DID keys string constants; all payload bytes literal numeric arrays. Resource lookup uses hex key generation, not multibyte endian conversion.

response_error_mapping.read: Flags checked only after every serial read succeeds; a failing read wins over pending user flag. Missing/short responses reject at wrapper or per-DID check; unknown valid value displays dedicated unknown resource, not failure.
response_error_mapping.timing: No timers/deadlines beyond asynchronous calls; controller read while-loops continue until nonzero result, with no wait/yield timer. New screen loops invoked unawaited.

mutation_cleanup_cancel.error: Cleanup failure never overrides returned workflow result. No stop-routine frame on errors; state returns001 after awaited dialog only for errors inside002/003 loops, initial errors stay001.

checkSupportP5.semantics: Read support map via reqType=0 reqBody=[0x22,0x01,0x01]; require resBody.length>=35. parsePhase5Support(result.apiArgs) optional-chain isSupport for 0x0100,0x0200,0x2000,0x2100,0x2200,0xF100. In that exact order, only for truthy page support, await reqBody=[0x22,highByte,0x00], again require length>=35, parse and filter supplied list to inclusive [(highByte<<8)|0x00,(highByte<<8)|0xFF]. For each filtered DID, append only if parser?.isSupport(did) is truthy. Undefined parser means no supported pages or no appended DIDs, not an explicit error.
checkSupportP5.failure_semantics: Any transport/parser/filter/length failure rejects {}; a failure after earlier pages discards partial support output. No retry in this method.

createInfFile.semantics: Build filename from local Date getters, V_ + verbatim VIN + _ + year + zero-padded month/day/hour/minute/second + .json; concatenate folderInfo + savedFile + one backslash + filename. Year is not padded; no VIN trim/sanitization, path normalization or directory creation.

createInfFile.failure_semantics: Any awaited stage or construction/stringify error rejects {}; no deletion/rollback of a partially created file is implemented.

readVin.semantics: Await SendMessageForUtility({reqType:0,reqBody:[0x22,0xF1,0x90]}). Slice result.apiArgs.resBody at 3; reject if data length<1 (does not require 17). Take first 17 bytes, await convertAsciiVin, then padEnd(21,space).
readVin.failure_semantics: Transport/access/empty-data/conversion rejection rejects {}; invalid nonzero VIN character instead converts to 17 spaces and then pads to 21, resolving successfully.

readJsonFileInfo.semantics: Sequentially obtain software ID, version, folder base, subfolder setting, folder information; preserve fileInfoList iteration order. For each fileInfo push folderInfo+savedFile+backslash+fileInfo.fileName, without additional filtering.

readEquippedEcuList.semantics: Local callback assigns mountedEcuList=model.commonInfo.getMountedEcuInfoList() synchronously and returns Promise.resolve(); no copying, filtering, PF call or inner await of returned value.
readEquippedEcuList.failure_semantics: No catch; thrown getter/call failure rejects the async method.

convertAsciiStandard.semantics: Iterate every supplied element; accept only >0x1F and <0x7F and concatenate String.fromCharCode. Any invalid element throws into local catch, which discards entire partial string and emits exactly data.length ASCII spaces. No trimming or partial replacement.

convertAsciiVin.semantics: Iterate indices 0 through 16 regardless of data.length. tempVin=data[i]?data[i]:0x20, so missing, zero or other falsy elements become space. Accept only >0x1F and <0x7F, concatenate String.fromCharCode. Any invalid truthy character causes complete replacement by 17 ASCII spaces; characters after index 16 ignored.

waitTime.semantics: Await gts.util.wait(time), then Promise.resolve(); no timer implementation or cancellation within assigned source.

startGeneralComm.semantics: Await one PF startGeneralComm({ecuId,busId}); no session transition or retry.
startGeneralComm.failure_semantics: PF rejection becomes Promise.reject({}); no cleanup in this method.

startExtendedSession.semantics: Await startGeneralComm, default-session transition, then extended-session transition, in exact order. Do not retry transitions.
startExtendedSession.failure_semantics: Any of these three awaits rejecting invokes and awaits GtsPFApi.endGeneralComm() (even if start failed); cleanup PF error is swallowed, then reject {}. No default-session cleanup transition in failure branch.

registerRepairRecord.semantics: Read the existing local file, resolve distributor/user-specific service configuration, submit record, poll completion, then attempt delete of same local file. Filename parameter jsonFolderPath is used as a file path. readData is sent as returned by readFile, with no JSON.parse of that file data.

ordered_effects.consume: JSON.parse(result.apiArgs.responseData); require commonResult?.statusCode === MIR2000000 and commonResult?.faultMessage undefined/null/empty string; id=responseData.apiResult?.ID (not otherwise validated)

polling_contract.construction: Create jsSHA(SHA-256,TEXT), update(id), getHash(HEX).toUpperCase(); create one JSON request string and PF arguments object before loop. timeOut=900000+1000 (901000 ms); startTimer=Date.now() before first wait; isLoop=true.

polling_contract.errors: wait, transport, parse, property access or hash-preparation failure propagates to outer worker catch, rejecting {}. No retry on an exception; only MIR2020000 repeats polling.
polling_contract.deadline_precision: Timeout checked only after pending response. A success response is accepted even if elapsed time exceeds timeout. No independent request timeout, hard deadline, iteration count or cancellation is implemented here.

algorithm: Object.entries(convMethodsObj).sort(([keyA],[keyB])=>Number(keyA)-Number(keyB)); Object.fromEntries sorted entries. Iterate Object.entries of that resulting object sequentially, awaiting the local async _loop for every method.

Return concatenated result. Numeric row keys impose order only; they are NOT write offsets. LSB_OFFSET.algorithm: requiredBytes=method.size/8; value=0; for i=0 while i<requiredBytes, value=(value << 8) | resBody[method.bytePos-4+i]. This is JS signed 32-bit bitwise assembly, big-endian; do not reinterpret it as unrestricted unsigned accumulation. If complement, signBit=1 << (size-1), fullMask=1 << size; if value & signBit, value-=fullMask. physicalValue=value*lsb+offset. Match dataType with /^F,%(\d+)\.(\d+)lf$/; parse decimalDigits from group2 only, call physicalValue.toFixed(decimalDigits). If string.length>strNum keep prefix slice(0,strNum); padStart(strNum,' '). Regex group1 is not used to enforce a separate width.
LSB_OFFSET.edge_behavior: No range/length/format checks. Bitwise shifts coerce undefined bytes to zero and wrap signed 32-bit; 32-bit raw high-bit values remain signed even when complement=false. Shift counts use JS modulo-32 semantics. Supplied table complement=true rows are 8/16-bit, listed exhaustively in table records. toFixed rounding and negative-zero representation follow JavaScript, not an independently idealized formula.

BINARY.algorithm: byte=resBody[bytePos-4]; bit=(byte >> bitPos) & 1; String(bit).padStart(strNum,' '). Only one bit is read, regardless of size; lsb, offset, complement and dataType are not applied. Missing byte bitwise-coerces to zero.

ASCII.algorithm: Loop i=0..size-1, accessing resBody[bytePos-4+i]. Each byte must be >0x1F and <0x7F (printable ASCII 0x20..0x7E). Append String.fromCharCode(byte). On first nonprintable or absent byte, reset entire asciiStr to empty and break. Return asciiStr.padStart(strNum,' '). size denotes bytes, not bits. No truncation if size exceeds strNum.

HEX.algorithm: For dataType==='H', nibbleCount=size*2 (size denotes bytes); otherwise nibbleCount=size/4 (size denotes bits). Begin byteIndex=bytePos-4, bitPos=method.bitPos, str=''. While nibbleCount>0, read byte and stop if !byte && byte!==0 (zero is accepted). If bitPos===7 append uppercase high nibble ((byte>>4)&15), then set bitPos=3 without moving byteIndex. Otherwise append uppercase low nibble (byte&15), set bitPos=7 and increment byteIndex. Decrement nibbleCount each iteration. Return str.padStart(strNum,' '). No truncation or scale/complement conversion.

PATTERN.algorithm: value=resBody[bytePos-4]; strValue=value.toString(10); if too long take prefix slice(0,strNum); padStart(strNum,' '). There is no pattern lookup or boolean mapping. size/lsb/offset/complement/dataType do not affect conversion. Missing value throws on .toString, unlike bitwise paths.

conversion.indexing_and_units: All routines subtract 4 from row.bytePos to index resBody. Numeric/binary/X-hex sizes are bits; ASCII/H-hex sizes are bytes. Row strNum is blank/final nominal field width. All padding is left ASCII space except whole empty-read field space repeats. Field results are strings; helper exceptions reject async processConvMethods and propagate through wrapper and rewrite.

SendMessageForUtility.rejection: PF rejection handler immediately dereferences response.apiArgs.resBody. Undefined resBody -> OTHER_ERROR /other error response. Empty -> NO_RESPONSE /no response. wait.behavior: new Promise(resolve=>setTimeout(resolve,time)); only scheduling and fulfillment; no clearTimeout, abort key or cancellation. Invocations50/100/300ms described in units. Loops have no retry ceiling.

createDeferred.behavior: Allocate deferred object and Promise executor storing deferred.resolve/reject. deferred.promise() returns same prom; callers resolve Yes/No string. No cancellation/default-resolution behavior.

Fulfillment: if response.response truthy replace that field with its .then(translate) and return response outer; otherwise return Promise.resolve(translate(response)). translate logs received value and returns Promise.resolve(response), no payload adaptation in these6 methods. No rejection handler in wrappers. Workflows supply no receiveAck; response-envelope contract/transport translation belongs next owner.

common_contracts.proved_equivalence: All seven member roles for 01–04 were read in full and compared after replacing unit identifiers. Controller flow, model forwarding, worker-api forwarding, nested worker callbacks and timer algorithms are identical apart from resource IDs, command/init names, RID low byte and countdown duration. Hnepb03 screen002 explainBox uniquely changes from i6419 to i6421; each unit binding below retains all differences.
common_contracts.entry/admission/input_domain: Controller init creates model/view/dialog/countdown view, awaits init worker, logs title then shows001. Worker init resolves currentEcuId through commonInfo.getEcuInfoByEcuId and replaces cache.data={ecuInfo,isAborted:false}. No text inputs; only start-setting, complete-setting, Next, Exit and dialog choices.

state_fields.controller: commonInfo,eventDisp,activityReport; model,cmnview(null spelling in constructor),cmnDlg,currentView,modalView initially null; isAbortedFlag=false,deferred=null. init additionally assigns cmnView. show001 resets only controller abort/deferred, not worker isAborted.
state_fields.worker: commandHandler={},buffer/commonInfo/ecuCache/cache/commandThread/storedCache=null; init stores commonInfo/ecuCache/commandThread and installs bound handlers; cache.data.ecuInfo and isAborted persist until init.
state_fields.view_dialog: View extends UtilityView; dialog/countdown extend GtsBaseView and each creates EventDispatcher. Dialog loaderDlg allocated lazily and cleared only by closeLoaderDialog.

guarded_ordered_transitions: 001 disposes prior currentView; G001 text instructions, disabled Next plus Exit and inserted start-setting button. Start emits settingstart =>002. Exit=>DL006: Yes emits backToUtilityMenu; No resolves. 002 disposes prior view; same G001 instructions with enabled Next and inserted settingcomplete button; complete returns001, Next starts routine.

Next awaits creation of DL007 no-button loader, creates already-resolved deferred, then awaits startExtendSession and startCableReset. Only after both succeed closes loader; awaits modal initView and countdown drawViewPane; disposes countdown; calls DL008 without awaiting its button promise; awaits outputResultCableReset; awaits stopKeepAlive; then awaits current deferred.promise().

Worker startExtendSession strictly starts general communication {ecuId,busId}, then startKeepAlive({}) (rejection swallowed), then transitSession({modeId:3}); returns {} or rejects {result:{errorNum:0}}. startCableReset sends start array and ignores positive payload beyond shared-wrapper echo checks; {} success, errorNum2 rejection.

Countdown modal loads own HTML with ViewUtil.getView(PAGE,ID), appends #modal_dialog, draws resource data, sets .d_screen_id and caches #v_progress_bar, opens modal {backdrop:static,keyboard:false}. draw replaces message newlines with
, writes remaining-time/unit resources; starts timer duration D with displayed D/1000. First update after1000ms, each decrements counter1000, displays it and writes width=(Date.now()-startTime)/D*100%; next delay1000-elapsed%1000 while counter>0; resolves at counter0. This counts ticks rather than derives remaining from elapsed; width not clamped. No close/cancel control.

outputResultCableReset begins errorNum2,startTime=null. Every iteration awaits abort-aware3000ms wait, then sends result array. Wait sets3000ms timeout and100ms interval; either timeout resolves or observed cache.isAborted rejects, both clear timeout+interval. It does not check abort during send. First positive wrapper response (including malformed/terminal) establishes startTime. Positive resBody.length<5 sets error1; byte4=1 repeats unless elapsed>=12000 then error3; byte4=2 succeeds; any other status rejects with error2. Transport/wrapper rejection sets error1. Loop continues only on rejected {isLoop:true}; timeout epoch is first positive response, not start-command or first delay. Outer catch yields {result:{errorNum}}.

DL008 cancel replaces deferred with unresolved deferred, closes loader, opens DL009 confirmation while polling continues. Yes awaits DL007 creation then awaits setIsAborted({isAborted:true}), sets controller.isAbortedFlag=true, resolves deferred. No reopens DL008 without waiting and resolves deferred. Completion and error handling both wait on deferred so no terminal UI is chosen before outstanding cancel answer.

After successful polling/cleanup/deferred: if aborted, awaits stopKeepAlive again, closes loader and emits menu; otherwise logs completion resource, closes loader and opens DL005. Catch always first awaits stopKeepAlive and deferred; aborted branch repeats cleanup and exits; otherwise closes loader and maps error. DL003 OK goes001 iff retry=true else menu; DL010 OK=>menu; DL005 OK=>menu. Unrecognized pressed IDs mostly resolve without navigation.

request_construction.forwarding: Other model methods forward {} unchanged; setIsAborted copies para.isAborted. WorkerApi constructs GtsWorkerApi(commonInfo), each method returns send(command,param) unchanged. Command prefix hnepb_NN., handler binds (model,model) so supplied command parameter becomes param.parameter. Worker registration guarded by !workerModels[HnepbNN].
request_construction.native_join: All raw messages go through shell.SendMessageForUtility -> GtsPFApi.sendMessage UG000015. General comm SC000013 chooses cached ecuId/busId; UG000013 keepalive, UG000004 modes3/1, UG000014 stop, SC000014 end. No security/DTC calls.

response_error_mapping.controller: 0=>shared comm-error dialog then001;1=>DL003 retry001;2/default=>DL003 OK menu;3=>DL010 OK menu. Worker poll positive=wrapper fulfillment, not local SID check.

common_contracts.user_visible_result: Two setting states expose different custom buttons; countdown before cancellable progress; operation success logs completion and DL005; malformed/no response retries via001, terminal status exits, 12-second busy timeout presents DL010.
common_contracts.mutation_cleanup_cancel: stopKeepAlive strictly transitSession({modeId:1}) -> stopKeepAlive() with NO args -> endGeneralComm({}), swallowing each failure, returns{}. No ECU routine-stop message on cancel. show001 does not clear worker abort; retry after a confirmed cancel is normally prevented by menu exit. dispose only disposes currentView if present and controller eventDisp; no session cleanup, countdown timer cancellation, modal disposal or dialog cleanup from dispose. Countdown dispose removes ALL .modal-backdrop and empties #modal_dialog, disposes own dispatcher; outstanding timers have no clear hook.

ecd-bridge.context: Proved for all seven complete model/API/worker members, not assumed from naming.
ecd-bridge.constructors: Every Model calls GtsBaseModel, retains commonInfo, constructs new HnecdNNWorkerApi() with no args. Every WorkerApi takes optional commonInfo and constructs GtsWorkerApi(commonInfo), so these callers pass undefined. Each worker singleton is installed only if !workerController.workerModels[HnecdNN]; constructor commandHandler={}, buffer/commonInfo/ecuCache/cache/commandThread/storedCache=null. init(commonInfo,ecuCache,commandThread) stores three references then registers each command bound(model,model). No hidden stores updated by business methods.
ecd-bridge.init_binding: 10/11 Model.init takes no args, reads commonInfo.getCurrentEcuId();12–16 accept ecuId captured by controller. Parameter {ecuId} travels through WorkerApi.send(exact command,param), worker reads param.parameter.ecuId and cache.data.ecuInfo=commonInfo.getEcuInfoByEcuId(ecuId). 10/11 init return {};12–16 return {result:true}. No ECU/bus input normalization.
ecd-bridge.parameters: Other models construct {} except11 boolean setters/transitSessionToDefault use shorthand named booleans,12 instructVnt uses {instructionRate},16 instructTarget uses {instructValue}. All are passed unchanged by matching WorkerApi method; no local catch/conversion/cancel ID. Each API commands map exactly hnecd_NN.methodName; handlers use same command. Every model and API method directly returns delegated promise. All methods enumerated and pinned in evidence.

ecd-framework.context: All seven controllers call GtsBaseController; retain commonInfo, new EventDispatcher,new ActivityLogger; fields model/cmnView and current/view null, some modalView/cmnDlg null as unit state records. Every view calls UtilityView(commonInfo); every Dialog calls GtsBaseView and new EventDispatcher. All local view.initView overrides are no-op Promise.resolve; create methods instantiate a separate UtilityView with named layout then return its initView result. No numeric/text input fields or validation callbacks in these seven utilities. Table selection false; click lambdas only trigger exact ViewEvent mapped in own controller.
ecd-framework.ownership: MenuShell owns inherited onErrorCommon/showCommErrorDialog, EventDispatcher, buttonPressed/autoClose, UtilityView rendering/resourceFormatter and layout templates. Local contracts specify exact contents/DOM mutations and invocation order, do not claim native outcomes. Replaced views dispose first. backPreviousScreen only triggers BACK_TO_UTILITY_MENU, returns resolved promise. No unit adds an abort signal, cancel request, timer handle clear, disposed flag, or background communication cleanup in dispose.

utility-response-helper.behavior: SendMessageForUtility constructs GtsPFApi and calls sendMessage(param), preserving reqType/body. Fulfillment reads response.apiArgs.resBody; for these utilities SID22/2E require strict echo resBody[1:3] == reqBody[1:3]; SID2F additionally requires resBody[3]===reqBody[3]. Mismatch logs and rejects {errorCode:gts.ERROR_CODE.ABNOMAL_RESPONSE,errorMessage:"error communication",response}. Fulfilled branch itself does NOT check positive SID or resultInfo.result or add a minimum-length predicate. Worker-specific length/predicate rules above remain distinct. Rejected PF branch: resBody undefined -> OTHER_ERROR; empty -> NO_RESPONSE; resBody[0]==127 -> NEGATIVE_RESPONSE with detail map NRC22 conditionsNotCorrect,31 requestOutOfRange,21 busyRepeatRequest,24 requestSequenceError,35 invalidKey, otherwise empty detail; nonpositive SID != reqMode+64 -> ABNOMAL_RESPONSE; remaining -> OTHER_ERROR. Every branch still rejects; no NRC retry/wait. Missing response.apiArgs can throw and workflow catches as ordinary failure.
utility-response-helper.pf_joins: GtsPFApi four methods startGeneralComm/endGeneralComm/transitSession/sendMessage log send/receive and pass param,receiveAck unchanged to raw interface. Fulfillment translate returns unchanged response; if response.response exists it wraps nested promise with translate and returns outer response; does not unwrap. No explicit receiveAck supplied by these workflows. Raw methods this.send PFCMD_START_GENERAL_COMM=SC000013, END_GENERAL_COMM=SC000014, TRANSIT_SESSION=UG000004, SEND_MESSAGE=UG000015. Native/session/transport outcome owned downstream.

timer-wait.behavior: Both actual gts.util.wait bodies equivalent: function(time){return new Promise(function(resolve){setTimeout(resolve,time);});}; no handle retained, cancellation, upper bound or timeout error. Unit awaits enforce ordering except expressly noted unreturned cleanup calls.

supplemental_reusable_contracts.state_fields: Constructs new GtsPFApi per call; captures reqMode=param.reqBody[0], does not copy request.
supplemental_reusable_contracts.guarded_ordered_transitions: Call GtsPFApi.sendMessage(param); attach fulfillment and rejection handlers. Fulfillment for22/2E strictly compares resBody[1] and[2] with request DID bytes; mismatch rejects ABNOMAL_RESPONSE (authored spelling). Otherwise returns original response. Success branch does not independently check SID positive-offset or NRC. Rejection handler accesses response.apiArgs.resBody; undefined maps OTHER_ERROR; empty maps NO_RESPONSE; byte0===0x7F maps NEGATIVE_RESPONSE with detail by byte2:22 CONDITIONS_NOT_CORRECT,31 REQUEST_OUT_OF_RANGE,21 BUSY_REPEAT_REQUEST,24 REQUEST_SEQUENCE_ERROR,35 INVALID_KEY,else empty detail. Else response SID!==reqMode+0x40 maps ABNOMAL_RESPONSE; matching SID on rejection still OTHER_ERROR. No retry.
supplemental_reusable_contracts.request_construction: Pass same param through sendMessage (UG000015); no ecuId/busId added here. Those are selected through preceding startGeneralComm session. All byte arrays in workflow contracts.
supplemental_reusable_contracts.response_error_mapping: Rejected errors are objects{errorCode,errorMessage,response}, plus detailCode for negative; messages other error response/no response/negative response/error communication. Workers flatten these per workflow result/rejection/status as documented; no NRC-specific dialogs in assigned workflows.
supplemental_reusable_contracts.user_visible_result: Indirect: enables numeric decode/write completion only after matching DID echo; common communication dialog or per-injector writeFailed text as assigned.
supplemental_reusable_contracts.mutation_cleanup_cancel: No cleanup, timer, retry or cancel. param/resBody not copied; Hnecd18 later explicitly mutates saved resBody alias outside helper.
supplemental_reusable_contracts.entry_admission_input_domain: All six workers call gts.util.SendMessageForUtility with reqType0 and reqBody SID22 or2E; scope here only those reached cases.

supplemental_reusable_contracts.guarded_ordered_transitions: return new Promise(resolve=>setTimeout(resolve,time)); caller awaits before subsequent reads. No timeout race with communication request.
supplemental_reusable_contracts.request_construction: No PF call; milliseconds passed unmodified to browser setTimeout.
supplemental_reusable_contracts.response_error_mapping: Promise resolves after timer; no reject/cancel API.

shared_contracts.context_linkage: All eight assigned workers call current gts.util.SendMessageForUtility with reqType0. Hndss02,Hngwy03,Hnfcm13,Hnfcm14 call current parsePhase5Support. Timer users Hndss01,Hndss02,Hnfcm03 use current wait. This equivalence is source-linked by evidence for each worker, not inferred from names.
shared_contracts.raw_success: GtsPFApi.sendMessage(param) resolved branch uses reqMode=param.reqBody[0] and response.apiArgs.resBody. For reqMode22/2E requires resBody[1/2] equal requested DID bytes;31 requires resBody[1] equal subfunction and resBody[2/3] equal routineID. Mismatch rejects {errorCode:gts.ERROR_CODE.ABNOMAL_RESPONSE,errorMessage:"error communication",response}. Otherwise returns original response unchanged. This resolved branch does not separately check positive response SID; that transport behavior remains PF owner.
shared_contracts.raw_reject: Rejected PF response with resBody undefined ->OTHER_ERROR/"other error response";empty->NO_RESPONSE/"no response". SID7F ->NEGATIVE_RESPONSE/"negative response",detailCode set NRC22 CONDITIONS_NOT_CORRECT,31 REQUEST_OUT_OF_RANGE,21 BUSY_REPEAT_REQUEST,24 REQUEST_SEQUENCE_ERROR,35 INVALID_KEY,otherwise empty string. Other SID not reqMode+0x40 ->ABNOMAL_RESPONSE; matching positive SID on PF rejection still OTHER_ERROR. Every rejection includes response wrapper. Workflow catches collapse these as documented per-unit; no implicit retry.
shared_contracts.support_parser: Accept SID62 with DID0101 or lowDIDbyte00 (data.slice3), or SID71 with RID1001 or lowbyte00 (data.slice4);else undefined; exceptions undefined. Group/index0101 combines pairs big-endian16, walksMSB->LSB with id=(pairIndex*16+bitPos0..15)*256. Lower groupHH00 combines pairsBE16, walks MSB->LSB with id=HH*256+pairIndex*16+bitPos1..16. Only completepairs processed. Phase5CommResultDataParser.parse returns input unchanged;isSupport(Xid1,Xid2) uses Xid1*256+Xid2 if Xid2!==undefined elseXid1 and returns dictionary value (canundefined). Shortpayload handling differs by workflow; parser has no32byte minimum itself.
shared_contracts.wait: new Promise(resolve=>setTimeout(resolve,time)); no cancellation handle returned, no clearTimeout provided by wait.
